entities.summary: Jean-Pierre Delville is a Belgian prelate of the Catholic Church who has been the Bishop of Liège since 2013. His earlier career was devoted to church history and teaching, which he always combined with pastoral activity. He has been associated with the Community of Sant'Egidio since 1978. Jean-Pierre Delville was a journalists & chroniclers from Liège (b. 1951-04-29, Liège). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
